title: A graph paper generator that renders vector PDFs in the browser
claim: Show HN: A graph paper generator that renders vector PDFs in the browser
why_good: A browser graph-paper generator that outputs vector PDFs — a tidy, useful utility for students, engineers and bullet-journalers.
value: Freemium/print-on-demand at best; a lovely tool, but graph paper is a commodity give-away.
risk: Trivially cloned, tiny willingness to pay; free templates abound — a nice utility, not a business.
